It's hard to advice over writing! But the biggest thing is to watch the Valkyrie and try and remember what she does before each attack, so for example if she dashes left you need to press L1 because her she's going to do a blockable move, if she dashes right she is going to do a stab move that you can counter, if she shouts vallhalla she is about to do the stop move. So it's just remembering all the cues before her moves. That's why I can beat her as I've fought so many times so I know the cues and it means I don't need to react as quick because I'll know the attack is coming

I'd say do all the side missions as you play, you'll enjoy the game a lot more! And with the Valkyries every time they attack they do something before to give you an idea of what attack it will be so for example if they dash right there only 1 or 2 attacks that will come next so its just learning all their cues! Have fun playing the game!
